copy.Üretime ve montaja yönelik tasarım, Poka: Design for manufacturing and assembly, Poka-Yoke, Muda, Kaizen, Six Sigma and FMEA: aligning design decisions with on-site efficiency.
copy.DFM/DFA ilkeleri ile yalın üretim araçla: It combines DFM/DFA principles and lean production tools; guides design and process improvement decisions.
copy.Yalın üretim ve DFM birlikte neden düşün: Why should lean manufacturing and DFM be considered together?
copy.Üretime yönelik tasarım (DFM) ve montaja: Design for manufacturing (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA) shape the manufacturing and assembly cost, error risk and takt time of the part at the design stage. Lean production principles make waste in the field visible and support a culture of continuous improvement. Separating the two can lead to design decisions reverting back to revision in the field.
copy.Makina imalatı ve özel ekipman projeleri: Typical goals in machinery manufacturing and special equipment projects are: reducing the number of parts, opting for standard connections and tolerances, simplifying the assembly direction and sequence, moving quality control points to an early stage.
copy.DFM ve DFA pratikte ne değiştirir?: What do DFM and DFA change in practice?
copy.DFM, seçilen üretim yöntemine (CNC, sac: DFM covers geometry, tolerance and material decisions appropriate to the selected production method (CNC, sheet metal, welding, casting, etc.). DFA, on the other hand, focuses on interface and fixing solutions that will reduce assembly time, tooling and the possibility of operator error. Both disciplines provide the greatest impact at the early design stage; Changes made after mass production are more costly.
copy.Poka-Yoke (hata önleyici tasarım), fizik: Poka-Yoke (error-proof design) makes incorrect assembly impossible or immediately apparent through physical or perceptual cues. It is especially valuable in repetitive assembly lines and new operator turnover.
copy.Six Sigma ve süreç yeteneği (Cp/Cpk) ana: Six Sigma and process capability (Cp/Cpk) analysis make variation measurable. FMEA (failure mode and impact analysis) prioritizes potential errors in the design or process. These tools complement each other: FMEA identifies risk, Poka-Yoke and DFM intervene at the design level, Kaizen continues the fine-tuning in the field.
copy.DFM: imalat yöntemi ve tolerans uyumu: DFM: manufacturing method and tolerance compliance
copy.DFA: montaj süresi ve hata riski: DFA: assembly time and risk of error
copy.İç ekip kapasitesi yeterli olduğunda bu: These principles can be applied internally when internal team capacity is sufficient. External consulting generally adds value in the following situations: new product line design, compatibility issues after supplier change, high error rate or deviation in assembly time, design review before transition to mass production.
copy.Danışmanlık kapsamı; mevcut durum analiz: Scope of consultancy; It can be defined as current situation analysis, design suggestions, workshop or training and application follow-up. Duration and scope are clarified on a project-by-project basis; Measurable targets (number of assembly steps, critical error types, etc.) are preferred over general percentage promises.
copy.Üretim danışmanlığı hizmetimizde tasarım: In our production consultancy service, we can handle design revision, subcontractor matching and manufacturing coordination together. DFM/DFA recommendations are translated directly into drawing and BOM updates; When necessary, we work in integration with our analysis or reverse engineering teams.
